title: ever FAYE|Plus Size Pleated Midi Ruffles Sleeve Chiffon Bridesmaid Dress
descriptionHtml:
This Plus Size Pleated Midi Ruffles Sleeve Chiffon Bridesmaid Dress exudes sophistication and movement. The pleated design adds texture and volume, while the asymmetrical hem creates a modern, dynamic look. Ruffled sleeves enhance its romantic charm, offering a flattering fit perfect for bridesmaids on any occasion.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Midi length.


Sleeve Style: Short sleeves.


Closure: It is concealed a zipper up the back.


Undergarments: It is not padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises chiffon.


Stretch: Fabric is no stretch.
